title: API Key Models
description: Account-scoped API keys used to authenticate non-interactive runs (CI/CD). The secret is shown once at creation and only ever stored as a hash.

ApiKeyScope.description: What a key is permitted to do. 'runs:execute' triggers test runs; 'runs:read' reads runs and reports.

ApiKeyStatus.description: Derived state of a key. Keys are never extended: an expired or revoked key is replaced by a new one.

ApiKey.description: An API key as returned by the API. Never carries the secret.

name.description: Human label shown in the UI and recorded on runs this key starts.

keyPrefix.description: Leading, non-secret portion of the key, so a key can be identified in a list without revealing it.

createdBy.description: User who created the key. Retained for audit; the key itself is the initiator of its runs.

expiresAt.description: Fixed at creation and immutable. Null means the key does not expire.

expiresInDays.description: Lifetime in days, fixed at creation. Omit or null for a key that does not expire.

CreateApiKeyResponse.description: Returned once at creation. This is the only time the secret is available.

secret.description: The full key. Never stored in plaintext and never retrievable again.
